sections.heading: Word from God
sections.body: Biblical teachings, Scripture reflections, and studies that explore what the Bible says and how it applies to everyday life.

hero_text:
Some words help us understand faith. Others give shape to feelings we struggle to express. Some take us into stories that exist only in imagination.

EverRock Write is a home for biblical reflections, poetry, life experiences, and original fiction. A place to explore Scripture, reflect on life, and share stories worth reading
